deals.evidence: a blended valuation of roughly $4.1 billion
deals.headline: NBA approves sale of Trail Blazers to Tom Dundon's group
deals.investor: Investor group led by Tom Dundon
deals.summary: Two-part transaction: Dundon's group buys 80% now and the remaining 20% by 2028 at a blended valuation of roughly $4.1bn (Sportico). The Athletic reported a $4.25bn price (via KATU); ESPN reported $4bn (via AP). Group includes Sheel Tyle, Marc Zahr, the Cherng Family Trust and Stanley Middleman.

ownership_summary: An investor group led by Tom Dundon (Dundon Capital Partners; owner of the NHL's Carolina Hurricanes) bought control from the Paul G. Allen estate in a two-part deal: 80% closed the week of 30 March 2026, the remaining 20% by 2028, at a blended valuation of roughly $4.1bn (Sportico). The group includes Sheel Tyle (Collective Global), Marc Zahr (Blue Owl Capital co-president), the Cherng Family Trust (Panda Express founders' family office) and Stanley Middleman.
